lede: Counter-Strike 2 was the day's clearest signal, holding first on Steam with 1,330,410 players online at once while its pro matches drew betting on Polymarket. Two other stories bridged separate feeds: No Man's Sky shipped its Cosmos update, turning up on both Hacker News and YouTube, and talk of GPT-6 Astra ran across Hacker News and Product Hunt. Quieter but telling, Apple's iPhone Duo topped Hacker News with 1,882 comments, and a small Python repo, ayghri/i-have-adhd, led GitHub trending with 4,650 new stars.

throughlines.title: Counter-Strike 2
throughlines.gist: Valve's shooter held the top of Steam's live charts with over 1.3 million concurrent players while its competitive matches drew money on Polymarket, the same game showing up as both play and wager.

throughlines.title: No Man's Sky Cosmos
throughlines.gist: The game's Cosmos update landed the same day across a Hacker News thread and a YouTube trailer, a sign a years-old title still pulls a crowd with each major patch.

throughlines.title: GPT-6 Astra
throughlines.gist: Chatter about OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, with its looped-transformer and hidden-reasoning claims, surfaced on Hacker News and Product Hunt at once, the dual appearance that tends to mark a model launch gaining traction.
